title: Building City-Scale Vision AI Systems in New Zealand
location: WG Building 2 Governor Fitzroy Place, Auckland Central, Auckland 1010, Auckland
description:
**嘉宾介绍 \| Guest Speaker**
**Derek Zhang**
Dr. Derek Zhang 是 Auckland Transport 的 Computer Vision Delivery Manager，负责领导 Vision AI 解决方案在城市交通网络中的设计、开发与落地。他拥有 Computer Vision 博士学位，从零构建了 AT 的 in-house 计算机视觉能力，打造了可扩展的 CV 平台与应用，有效提升了交通安全、运营效率以及数据驱动决策能力。
Derek 擅长将前沿的 Vision AI 技术转化为企业级的实际应用成果，同时注重打造高绩效团队，并推动跨团队与 stakeholder 的紧密协作。

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-

**主题 \| Topic**

本次分享将探讨 Computer Vision 如何从实验性的 AI 技术，逐步发展为现代城市中的关键基础设施。基于在 Auckland Transport 的真实实践经验，Dr. Derek Zhang 将介绍 Vision AI 系统是如何被设计、部署并扩展，以支撑城市级交通网络运行。

内容将从通俗易懂的角度介绍 Computer Vision 的基本概念及工作原理，并结合实际案例（如 incident detection、traffic monitoring、safety analytics），展示如何将视频数据转化为可执行的洞察，从而提升城市运行效率与安全性。
此外，分享还将深入讲解这些系统背后的构建方式，包括实时平台、数据管道、系统运维，以及隐私与公众信任等关键考虑。
最后，Derek 将结合实践总结关键经验，并分享在构建 in-house 能力和实现 AI 规模化落地过程中的领导力思考与职业发展建议。

title: AI + Gaming: A Whole New World
description:
***DIFFERENT LOCATION!* This is a new casual mini-session format - on a weeknight over dinner.**

This session explores how AI is reshaping every stage of the gaming experience - from the core mechanics and player interactions to the very way games are designed, developed, and consumed.

The focus is practical and aimed at game developers, designers, students, and anyone trying to make sense of how gaming actually works now - but players, industry professionals, and tech enthusiasts will get plenty out of it too.

We'll explore-

* where AI is already making waves in game engines, analytics, and player support
* AI's role in asset generation, level design, character animation, and automated playtesting
* how advanced AI is creating more immersive NPCs, adaptive storylines, and personalized player experiences
* AI-assisted game design tools, generative content, and unleashing new possibilities for developers
* Ethical considerations and player trust - navigating issues like fairness, bias in AI-generated content, and the future of player agency
* Understanding the future player - how AI will reshape player engagement, community building, and the very definition of fun

After this session we can hang out as long as we like at the restaurant if you want to keep the conversation going and connect with other professionals.

title: Sit & Think: Inaugural Session of a Rhetorical Forum
location: 2 Freyberg Place, Auckland CBD, Auckland 1000, Betty Wark Room, Auckland
description:
This is the first full session of Sit & Think, a new civil community forum inspired by the spirit of free exchange of ideas at Walk & Talk meetups. The session features a short talk on a theme from politics, philosophy, or public life, followed by a hands-on exercise and an open, facilitated discussion. Sit & Think is hosted by Dr Dmitry Zavialov.

The inaugural session, presented by Walk & Talk Auckland in partnership with the Ellen Melville Centre, introduces a practical toolkit for reading rhetoric: how to spot when a message appeals to your reason, your emotions, or your trust in authority, and how to tell the difference between persuasion and manipulation. The tools we practise in this session are the same ones we will use to hold ourselves to a higher standard of conversation in every session that follows.

No prior knowledge required. No prep, no reading. Just bring your curiosity and your willingness to think. Places are limited; make sure to RSVP.

**How the room works**

Disagreement is welcome. Dominance is not. You do not need to agree with anyone, but we ask that you disagree with the idea, not the person; that you listen before you respond; and that you make room for voices other than your own. This is not a debate, and there is no winner. If you tend to speak a lot, practise holding back. If you tend to hold back, this is a room where your voice is wanted. The facilitator will step in if the conversation needs steering. That is the job, not a criticism of anyone.

**📅 When:** Saturday 25 July, 1:00 PM to 3:00 PM
**📍 Where:** Betty Wark Room, Ellen Melville Centre, 2 Freyberg Place, Auckland CBD
**🎙️ Format:** Short talk → group analysis → pair exercise → open discussion
**💵 Cost:** Free. Koha welcome.
**♿ Access:** Ground floor, accessible venue.
Presented by Walk & Talk Auckland in partnership with the Ellen Melville Centre.

title: OWASP New Zealand - Auckland Meetup
description:
Join us for the next **OWASP New Zealand Chapter** meetup! We are gathering the local application security community for an evening of technical talks, networking, and knowledge sharing.

* **When:** Tuesday, 14th July 2026
* **Where:** **Lightspeed Office** 2 Nuffield Street, Newmarket, Auckland 1023, New Zealand
* **Time:** 5:30 PM (Doors open for networking), 6:00 PM (Presentations begin)

We present an introductory talk about the OWASP Top 10 (2025 edition) with a new item each meeting. With the new edition OWASP Top 10, we're starting at A01:2025 Broken Access Control.

**Thanks to Our Host**
A big thank you to [Lightspeed](https://www.lightspeedhq.com/au/) for sponsoring the venue and catering and for supporting the local security community.

**Agenda**

* 6:00 PM OWASP Introduction, Top 10
* 6:30 PM Break
* 6:45 PM Technical Talk

**Technical Topic Speaker: Ricky Gummadi**
Ricky Gummadi is a Senior Solution Architect at Microsoft, based in Auckland, focused on AI, cloud architecture, and developer platforms. He works closely with enterprise customers across New Zealand to design and implement production-ready AI systems. Ricky is also part of the core development team contributing to the Agent Governance Toolkit, with a focus on enabling safe, reliable, and governed agentic AI workloads.
**Talk Title: Agentic AI Governance**
As AI systems evolve from assistants to autonomous agents, the focus shifts from what the model says to what the system actually does. This talk introduces the Agent Governance Toolkit (AGT), a framework for bringing deterministic, runtime governance to agentic systems. We’ll explore why prompt-based safety is not sufficient for production scenarios, walk through the OWASP Agentic Top 10 risks, and look at how policies, identity, sandboxing, and observability can be applied to mitigate these risks in real-world architectures.

location: MOTAT, 805 Great North Road and 98 Motions Road, Western Springs, Auckland, Auckland
description:
LIVE Days are interactive and hands-on days filled with learning, play and special moments, perfect for the whole whānau!
With live entertainment, collection items, plus plenty of activities - there's a little something for everyone.
This July at LIVE DAY: Weather Science uncover the stories of the weather-related stars in the Matariki cluster, Waipunarangi and Ururangi.
Waipunarangi is associated with the various forms of rain that we experience throughout the year as it falls from the sky and washes over the earth, nourishing all living things. If you can’t see Waipunarangi clearly during Matariki, the year will bring lots of rain and maybe some flooding. If she’s bright and clear, the rain will be light.
Ururangi connects us to the different winds and this whetū determines the nature of these winds. If Ururangi is hard to see when the cluster of Matariki rises, the year will be windy. If he is bright and clear, the winds will be calm.
Make and take home your own cloud finder, have fun with weather science experiments featuring raindrops and rainbows, and find out more about the different winds and how they work at our latest exhibition Ngā hau a Tāwhirirangi Forces of Flight, in the Aviation Hall.

title: 「週会」日本語と英語ソーシャルグループ水曜会 / English-Japanese Social Group "Shuukai" Wednesday Meet
location: 143 Carlton Gore Rd, New Market, Auckland 1023, Newmarket, Auckland
description:
日本語版は下にあります。スクロールしてご覧下さい

Hello! Are you interested in getting useful conversation practice in English and Japanese? We're holding an English - Japanese social group at Gilli Cafe on Carlton Gore Road, Newmarket!

**Participation fee:**

$11 to be paid at the counter (Includes regular flat white, coffee, tea, or a fizzy drink)

**Guidelines:**

\- After getting your participation slip and your drink from the counter\, you will be given a number token with your assigned table number in which you'll meet 3 other people that want to practice their language skills\. Maximum of 4 people per table\.
\- There's no set topic so feel free to talk about whatever you want :\)
\- The tables will be shuffled in intervals of 25 minutes and you will get a new number token\, so you will have many opportunities to talk to different people\.
\- All language levels are welcome\. Feel free to bring along questions or content from your language study or just have a friendly chat with the people at your table\.
\- This event is only for people aged over 18 years old\.

So please come to Gilli Cafe at 6 PM on Wednesday if you are interested in working on your English or Japanese :) We'll be waiting for you!

こんにちは！私たちといっしょに英語もしくは日本語の会話練習をしませんか？NewmarketにあるGilli Cafeで、英語と日本語のミートアップを社交の場として提供しています。

**参加費：**

$11（注文カウンターでお支払いください。含まれるドリンク：レギュラーフラットホワイト、コーヒー、紅茶、または炭酸飲料）

**ガイドライン：**

・注文カウンターで参加票とお飲み物を受け取ったあと、番号付きのトークンをもらってください。トークンにはあなたの座席番号が書かれていて他の参加者と一緒に言語交換を行います。1テーブルは最大4人です。
・特に決まったテーマはないので、好きなことを自由に話してください :)
・25分ごとに新しい番号トークンが渡され、席替えします。多くの人との会話を楽しむことができます。
・どんな言語レベルの方でも大歓迎です。言語学習について話をしたり、自分の教材を持参したり、ただ世間話をしたり、などなど。自由に会話を楽しんでください。
・18歳以上の方のみ参加可能。

英語もしくは日本語の練習をしたい！という方は水曜日の午後6時にGilli Cafeに是非お越しください！お待ちしています :)

title: School Holidays with Auckland Council Pools and Leisure
description:
Give your kids an unforgettable winter break filled with fun, adventure and new friendships at our Auckland Council Pools and Leisure School Holiday Programme!
These winter holidays, we’ve lined up the perfect mix of cosy indoor activities, exciting outings and creative challenges to keep kids aged 5-13 entertained every day - rain, shine or chilly skies.
Enrol them in our school holiday programme - it’s affordable, safe, varied and packed with winter fun.
What’s in store these holidays?

Frosty adventures - challenges, team-building fun and quizzes to defrost your brain!
Cool excursions - movie days, ice skating and trips to some of Auckland’s favourite attractions!
Game on - sports showdowns, gymnastics and arcade games to keep you warm and active!
Cosy creativity - crafty creations, pyjama days and more!

How to get ready for all the fun? Simply pack a lunch, snacks, water, a hat and comfy clothes - and bring along a big smile for the winter adventure ahead!
Spaces are limited, so don’t miss out. Head to our website to check out your local centre’s schedule, download an enrolment form or pop in to sign up today!
